patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans email-outreach; Salesloft leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning email-outreach vs Salesloft-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
